hyperparameters.name: posterior samples for estimating counterfactual effects
additional posterior samples for conditional variance

methods.name: r-SSE-ICC
methods.description: attributes contribution ratios to all state variables

methods.name: total agent-specific effect (tot-ASE)
methods.description: isolates the effect of the intervention that propagates only through the agents (A1, A2 and Planner)

methods.name: state-specific effect (SSE)
methods.description: isolates the effect of the intervention that propagates only through states

methods.name: reverse SSE
methods.description: computes the difference between the returns of the counterfactual trajectories considered for tot-ASE and TCFE

methods.name: ASE-SV
methods.description: Method that attributes the effect efficiently to the clinician and AI

methods.name: Gini coefficient
methods.description: Statistical measure used to depict how spread attribution scores are across state variables

methods.name: Planner-Actor-Reporter system
methods.description: System akin to (Dasgupta et al., 2023) where Planner is implemented using a pre-trained LLM and few-shot learning to provide actors with instructions.
